monsters.fact: Floors 1 through 9 are populated by Goblins (plus Prairie wolves on Floor 2, Harpies on Floor 4, and Goblin raiders on Floor 8), using Subjugation, Conquest, Survival, and Explore mission types.
Floor 11 introduces Skeletons (Subjugation, 'Annihilate your enemies', Chapter 38).
Floors 12 through 19 are dominated by Human soldiers (with assassins, mages, and a human knight appearing on Floor 15), spanning Subjugation, Guard, and Exploration mission types.
monsters.quote: 12 | Subjugation | Annihilate your enemies | Human soldiers | 44-46

monsters.fact: Lizardmen are the dominant enemy type across Floors 25-30 (including Lizardman chief, sorcerers, riders, shamen, and fighters).
